limitations: Prescribed axisymmetric geometry; no motion, rim evolution, sixfold branching, surface diffusion, nucleation stochasticity, aggregation or fracture.
Outer Dirichlet boundary stays finite and is refined separately from the grid.
Molecular jumps and ventilation absent. Isothermal-crystal latent heating is optional and omits a substrate heat sink.
Sharp-corner sample values require mesh refinement; corner extrapolation is numerical evidence, not a measured tip radius.
Published broad/narrow attachment parameter limits do not define an autonomous interpolation in rim width.
